title: Passing experience towards living growth

captions.emotions: Warm pleasure in other people developing

meaning: Progress in a meaningful endeavour can inspire you when passing experience on brings the pleasure of seeing others develop.
text: A shared path can continue through knowledge you offer. The Chariot in the energy of Sahasrara supports a wish to advance an important intention, find direction and move through obstacles. The Hierophant in the physical position describes shared actions: learning within a chosen tradition, explaining foundations and transmitting experience. The Empress in emotions brings warm pleasure when usefulness develops and bears fruit. It feels rewarding that your participation helps a larger endeavour grow through others. What is transmitted enters intentions of their own without having to reproduce only your initial goal or a familiar result.

For example, you teach new guides a simple way to lead a walk about urban architecture. Together, you explain attentive observation and show how a question can connect with an accessible example. **A shared intention grows when what you transmit becomes someone else’s independent skill.** A participant notices an interesting detail on their everyday route and suggests another gathering. Warm pleasure concerns continuation itself: your knowledge already helps new people see the city and share their attention with others.

The difficulty may arise if transmission requires a future guide to copy your examples. An original route seems insufficiently correct although the foundation has been understood. Directed motivation and the pleasure of development remain supportive. Action benefits from separating the essential skill from your particular method, preserving substance while allowing another place, question and accessible first step.
